meaning: A way to get something now and pay in smaller parts later, such as four payments over a few weeks.
clues: You get the item right away, but you pay for it later, in parts.
Shops offer it at checkout, online or in the store.
A common plan splits what you owe into four payments, a couple of weeks apart.
Many plans charge no interest, but late payments can bring fees.
It has four words. Its nickname is four letters: B, N, P, L.
assumes: Layaway keeps the item at the store until you finish paying
A debit card takes money from your account right away

decoys.meaning: A store plan where you pay a little at a time. You take the item home only after the last payment.
A card you load with money ahead of time. You can spend only what you loaded.
A plastic card linked to your bank account. When you pay with it, the money comes straight out of your account.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, layaway meant the store held your coat until it was paid for. We called it patience.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: This one is different: you take it home right away. Check the late fees first, and be sure you can cover each payment.

short: Get it now, pay in parts
